name: event_id
description: UUID v4 generated once where the event happens. Retries reuse it, so it is the deduplication key.

name: event_name
description: The event's name, one of the events in the contract.

name: schema_version
description: Version of the tracking contract the sender was built against.

name: source
description: Where the event was produced. Each event has exactly one source.

name: event_timestamp
description: When the event happened, in UTC, as defined by the event's event_time. Set once; retries and delayed delivery never change it.

name: server_timestamp
description: When sGTM received the event, in UTC. The table is partitioned on it.

name: user_id
description: The app's user ID as a string. Null when nobody is logged in.

name: anonymous_id
description: UUID v4 identifying the browser. Null without analytics consent.

name: session_id
description: UUID v4 identifying the browser session. Null without analytics consent.

name: consent
description: Consent Mode v2 signals at the time of the event.

fields.name: analytics_storage
fields.description: Consent for analytics identifiers. Unknown counts as denied.

fields.name: ad_storage
fields.description: Consent for advertising identifiers. Null when not collected.

fields.name: ad_user_data
fields.description: Consent to send user data to advertising platforms. Null when not collected.

fields.name: ad_personalization
fields.description: Consent for personalised advertising. Null when not collected.

name: properties
description: Event-specific properties, as defined per event in the contract. An empty object when there are none.
